thesis: This episode argues that major tech companies like Meta and Microsoft are leading advancements in VR/AR with enterprise-focused devices, while Google, IBM, and Rigetti are pioneering quantum computing through noisy intermediate-scale systems. The discussion highlights a clear bullish stance on VR/AR innovation and a neutral but forward-looking perspective on quantum computing progress.
